model_sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name
FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }} c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'orders') }} o
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
)
